 1054:   String generateBasicAuthHeader(String apiKey) {
 1055:     String credentials = '$apiKey:';

  538:   void setDepartureMarker(double lat, double long) {

  555:     if (Constant.selectedMapType == 'osm') {
  556:       // Add new stop marker without clearing
  557:       osmMarker.add(flutterMap.Marker(point: latlong.LatLng(lat, lng), width: 40, height: 40, child: stopIconOsm!));
  558: 
  559:       getDirections(isStopMarker: true);
  560:     } else {
  561:       final markerId = MarkerId('Stop $index');
  562: 
  563:       markers.removeWhere((marker) => marker.markerId == markerId);
  564:       markers.add(Marker(markerId: markerId, infoWindow: InfoWindow(title: 'Stop ${String.fromCharCode(index + 65)}'), position: LatLng(lat, lng), icon: stopIcon!));
  565: 
  566:       getDirections();
  567:     }
  568:   }

  570:   void _setOsmMarker(double lat, double lng, {required bool isDeparture}) {
  571:     final marker = flutterMap.Marker(point: latlong.LatLng(lat, lng), width: 40, height: 40, child: isDeparture ? departureIconOsm! : destinationIconOsm!);
  572:     if (isDeparture) {
  573:       departureLatLongOsm.value = latlong.LatLng(lat, lng);
  574:     } else {
  575:       destinationLatLongOsm.value = latlong.LatLng(lat, lng);
  576:     }
  577:     osmMarker.add(marker);

  589: 
  590:     if (isDeparture) {
  591:       departureLatLong.value = pos;
  592:     } else {
  593:       destinationLatLong.value = pos;
  594:     }
  595: 
  596:     // Remove only the matching departure/destination marker
  597:     markers.removeWhere((marker) => marker.markerId == markerId);
  598: 
  599:     // Add new marker
  600:     markers.add(Marker(markerId: markerId, position: pos, icon: icon, infoWindow: InfoWindow(title: title)));
  601: 
  602:     mapController.animateCamera(CameraUpdate.newLatLngZoom(pos, 14));
  603: 
  604:     if (departureLatLong.value.latitude != 0 && destinationLatLong.value.latitude != 0) {
  605:       getDirections();
  606:     } else {
  607:       mapController.animateCamera(CameraUpdate.newCameraPosition(CameraPosition(target: LatLng(lat, lng), zoom: 14)));
  608:     }
  609:   }

  876:     final isDestinationEmpty = destinationLatLongOsm.value.latitude == 0.0 && destinationLatLongOsm.value.longitude == 0.0;

  881: 
  882:       // Clear OSM markers (if using OSM)
  883:       osmMarker.clear();
  884: 
  885:       // Clear Google markers (if using Google Maps)
  886:       markers.clear();
  887: 
  888:       // Clear route points (optional)

  890: 
  891:       // Reset distance and duration values
  892:       distance.value = 0.0;
  893:       duration.value = '';
  894:     }
  895:   }

  767:     Map<String, String> requestBody = {'grant_type': 'client_credentials'};

  770:       Uri.parse(apiUrl),
  771:       headers: <String, String>{'Authorization': "Basic ${orangeMoneyModel.value.auth!}", 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
  772:       body: requestBody,
  773:     );
  774: 
  775:     // Handle the response

  770:       Uri.parse(apiUrl),
  771:       headers: <String, String>{'Authorization': "Basic ${orangeMoneyModel.value.auth!}", 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded', 'Accept': 'application/json'},
  772:       body: requestBody,
  773:     );
  774: 
  775:     // Handle the response
  776: 
  777:     if (response.statusCode == 200) {
